_meta.description: 8-qubit single-copy noisy native-gate simulations; entropy index 0=boundary, 1=bulk. QST uses K noisy trajectories per Pauli basis, with shots split across trajectories.
_meta.qst_sampling_definition: For each Pauli basis and QST repeat, K noisy trajectories are generated; shots are split across those trajectories and combined into one counts dictionary.
